verdict.rationale: LibreChat is a self-hosted web app (Docker/npm/Helm) whose custom endpoints include local providers like Ollama. That lets a user keep conversations off third-party services entirely, or route through provider APIs instead of consumer chat apps. A community comment notes OpenAI trains on ChatGPT history but not API usage. However, no documentation explicitly states a no-training guarantee or offers a training opt-out control, so protection depends on the user's deployment and provider choices. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party privacy or no-training policy, documented guidance on avoiding provider-side training, and independent corroboration.
